game: NYJ@TB Week 3 2025 / 2025-09-21 13:00 ET / TB -6.5 / total 43.5 / outdoors, weather not saved

script.base: Tampa is the lead side at home outdoors (implied 25.0 to 18.5). With Justin Fields out, the Jets' two-game run identity (Fields 17 carries, 97 yards) is gone, so NYJ is more likely to stall and trail than to control the clock. Tampa, facing a Jets front missing DE Jermaine Johnson II and DT Jay Tufele and a defense that has bled the right side (8.77 YPA on 30 attempts) and been crushed when it blitzes (TB 0.45 EPA/dropback vs blitz vs 0.07 vs none; NYJ blitz 29%), should get out in front and hand Bucky Irving the late carries. Breece Hall's rush efficiency is the casualty against a Bucs run defense at 3.42 YPC.
script.flip1: The unnamed backup QB and Hall grind a low-event game, the Jets stay inside one score, and the dog-throws-more script never shows up. Hall inherits a chunk of Fields' 8.5 rush attempts per game (Nwangwu is also out), Irving is stuck in his 37-yard week, and both rush legs lose.
script.flip2: Tampa scores early and the game gets to two scores. Jets abandon the run, so Hall's rush line dies, but garbage-time targets lift Wilson (17 targets, 145 yards with Fields) and Hall's receiving piece (7 targets, 47 yards). Irving's closer carries still fit unless the lead is big enough to cut starter snaps, which a 6.5 spread does not strongly imply.

injury_fallout: Source: pack official pre-game injury report. NYJ QB Justin Fields Out (concussion) removes 17 carries and 97 rush yards from the two-game sample and the QB who produced the Wilson/Hall stat lines; the backup is not named in the pack. NYJ WR Josh Reynolds Out (hamstring) is only 3 targets and 18 yards, a small redistribution toward Wilson (17 targets), Tyler Johnson (3/31) and Jeremy Ruckert (3/21). NYJ RB Kene Nwangwu Out leaves Hall (29/136) and Braelon Allen (8/20) as the only listed backs, so Hall's carry share can rise even as the script cuts rush rate. NYJ DE Jermaine Johnson II Out and DT Jay Tufele Out thin the front Tampa runs and throws against (NYJ already allows 4.86 YPC). NYJ CB Michael Carter II and S Tony Adams are only Questionable, so a slot/safety downgrade for Shepard/Egbuka/Evans is not confirmed. TB WR Chris Godwin Out (ankle) leaves Evans (19 targets, 107 yards, 268 air), Egbuka (Questionable, hip; 13 targets, 96 yards) and Shepard (10 targets, 73 yards). TB T Tristan Wirfs Out (knee) is a direct hit on Tampa's run fits and Mayfield's blind-side protection, which caps the Irving over. No final inactives in the pack.

matchup.pressure: TB blitz rate 34%; NYJ EPA/dropback 0.04 vs blitz and 0.05 vs none (flat, and that sample is with Fields, who is out). NYJ blitz rate 29%; TB EPA/dropback 0.45 vs blitz vs 0.07 vs none. Jets' missing Johnson and Tufele should make pressure even harder to generate. Pressure that does get home would cut deep WR yards and push checkdowns to Hall and Otton; the pack cannot separate blitz from pressure rate.
matchup.bleeds: TB run defense is the stingy unit: 3.42 YPC and only 3 runs of 10-plus in two games, but it bleeds right-side passes (10.56 YPA). NYJ run defense bleeds at 4.86 YPC with 3 runs of 10-plus, and the pass defense bleeds right (8.77) and left (6.89) while the middle is the only firm zone (4.11 on 9 attempts). NYJ also allows explosives (7 passes of 20-plus); TB allows 8 of 20-plus.
matchup.overlap: Jets' top option is Garrett Wilson (17 of 39 listed targets, 43.6% share, 159 air yards). That overlaps TB's right-side leak (10.56 YPA) only if he aligns there, which is not charted, and it conflicts with a new QB plus a 34% blitz that the Fields-era EPA does not show he beats. Tampa's overlap is clearer on the ground: Irving's 31 of 43 RB carries into a 4.86 YPC Jets front that is also down two defensive linemen. Evans' 268 air yards overlap the Jets' explosive allowance, but his 5.6 yards per target (107 yards on 19 targets) has not cashed that yet.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and the Hall under lost because Fields' 17 carries did not vanish, they became Hall handoffs with Nwangwu out and Allen stuck at 2.5 YPC, the Jets stayed close (flip 1), and 20 carries at even 3.5 YPC cleared 68.5 the same way the 107-yard week did; TB's 3.42 YPC is two games and may be a pass-funnel (right side 10.56 YPA) rather than a stuffed front. The Irving over lost because Wirfs' knee wrecked the fits, Irving repeated 37 yards at 3.5 YPC, White's 65-yard game showed the committee can flip, and Mayfield just kept throwing into a 0.45 EPA blitz matchup. Both numbers were unpriced medians, so there was no edge versus a sharp anchor if the read was only directionally right.
slip_story: One story only: Tampa control game, not a shootout. Favorite clock stack is Irving rush over; dog rush-dies stack is Hall rush under. They win together if TB leads and NYJ cannot run. Do not add Wilson or Evans overs, a Hall receiving over, or a game under on the same slip; those need the opposite script. No TD legs. Egbuka is a no-play while questionable. Not a bet without a price.
